Is it a good idea to build my own paint spraying system?
In a word No I can not support this. There is a reason why spray equipment is expensive and complex, it is because it is not made for DIY. There is the potential to save substantial money if you build your own, but you risk having to re-fix/update it when it doesn’t work as you would expect. Do your research, know your way around a toolbox and have no problem with building things, but remember spray equipment is a professional tool.
DIY painting tips
- Check out the safety information prior to starting
- Take a look at the parts that aren’t going to use, and decide how they’ll be stored before your project
- Plan your project out. Take a moment to figure out what you need to do, and think about how long it could take
- Organise your schedule. If you’re going to need a lot of time, and you’re just doing the project one weekend, then it might be better to call up a friend and make a plan
- Organise your space. You will need to keep your workspace safe and accessible to all the tools you will need. Keep a small trash can nearby, or else, you have to pause every few minutes to dump anything you’ve just sprayed
- Plan your route carefully. No matter how much experience you might have, using a sprayer takes a lot of practice. Make sure you take a good amount of time before spraying too near the end of the wall
